data.name: Thrall
data.description: You can treat one member of your collective as if a thrall and that member will follow any instruction given by you.  Like a thrall, if this member dies while under this effect, you suffer one negative level for one day.  This thrall effect can be ended by the commander as a free action, but otherwise is treated as a permanent effect.  The targeted collective member may make a Will save (DC %1) if you give any commands that would cause the thrall to harm itself or obviously suicidal orders.|UnwillingParticipantDC
